free_tier_limits.correction: Free plan is free to start (no monthly platform fee) with pay-as-you-go labels; there is no fixed monthly free-label allotment published as a pure free API quota — platform fees apply per label after any promotions. Confirm current free-label promotions and platform fees on the pricing page.

example.correction: Tracking create is POST /tracks/ with JSON body {"carrier","tracking_number"} and Authorization: ShippoToken; the entry's curl omits -X POST (GET is the default for curl without -d behavior varies). Prefer: curl -X POST https://api.goshippo.com/tracks/ -H "Authorization: ShippoToken YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"carrier":"usps","tracking_number":"..."}'. Also ShippoToken scheme is correct per auth docs.
